As someone with severe ADHD that gets massively overwhelmed when I do not have a cleaning routine (and the house shows it), these cleaning pages have really helped me with a starting point to get the house in order again. I love that there are both filled and unfilled sheets - the filled sheets definitely have helped the most to get me out of my little shame spiral and actually motivated to start cleaning. Honestly, solid dopamine hit; I highly recommend these if you also struggle to find a routine that works for you. I've only been using these a few days, but I can see these becoming habitual once I really see how much cleaner our home is.
